snippet.title: Hidden Magical Creatures - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Demo and Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3339510/Hidden_Magical_Creatures/

Hidden Magical Creatures is a hidden object game where you need to find all the magical creatures from other worlds and return them home!
